;Armed conflicts and attacks
*A suicide bomber attacks a government building in [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]], and causes the collapse of an adjacent school. Three deaths and 14 injuries are reported. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-45387620 (BBC)]
*[[Moro conflict]]; [[2018 Isulan bombings]]
**Another bombing incident occurs in [[Isulan]], [[Sultan Kudarat]], in the [[Philippines]], when an [[improvised explosive device]] explodes outside an internet café, killing one person and injuring 15 others. [https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/news/regions/666332/second-explosion-hits-isulan-sultan-kudarat-at-least-1-killed/story/ (GMA News)]
*[[Second Libyan Civil War]]
**Around 400 prisoners, mostly supporters of the late [[Libya]]n dictator [[Muammar Gaddafi]], escape from a detention facility in [[Ain Zara]], near [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]], amid fighting between rival militia groups. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-45392172 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Vietnam floods]]
**Heavy floods that started again across [[Vietnam]] have killed at least 14 people, while four others are declared missing. Also, 375 houses were damaged and 661 cattle killed. [https://www.firstpost.com/world/14-killed-4-missing-in-vietnam-floods-says-countrys-natural-disaster-prevention-and-control-agency-5113921.html (''Firstpost'')]
*A bus crashes in the [[Andes]] in [[Ecuador]], leaving 11 people dead and 37 injured. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/eleven-killed-in-latest-ecuador-bus-crash-10676306 (Channel NewsAsia)]
*[[National Museum of Brazil fire]]
**A massive fire destroys most of the [[Paço de São Cristóvão]], which houses the [[National Museum of Brazil]], in [[Rio de Janeiro]]. The museum holds important archaeοlogical and anthropological objects, including the remains of the [[Luzia Woman]], [[Marajoara culture|Marajoara]] vases and [[Egyptian mummies]]. [https://g1.globo.com/google/amp/rj/rio-de-janeiro/noticia/2018/09/02/incendio-atinge-a-quinta-da-boa-vista-rio.ghtml (G1)] [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-brazil-fire-museum/rios-200-year-old-national-museum-hit-by-massive-fire-idUKKCN1LJ00C (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[War in Donbas (2014–2022)|War in Donbass]]
**Tens of thousands of people attend the funeral of [[Alexander Zakharchenko]]. Yesterday, [[Russia]]n [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Russia)|Foreign Minister]] [[Sergei Lavrov]] said that the murder was a provocation and that it would derail the stalled [[Normandy format]] peace process. [https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-separatists-mourn-donetsk-leader-zakharchenko/a-45324994 (Deutsche Welle)]
*[[Crisis in Venezuela]], [[Foreign_relations_of_the_Republic_of_Ireland#Americas|Foreign relations of Ireland to the Americas]]
**[[Ireland]] protests in response to the [[Venezuela]]n government seizing a [[Smurfit Kappa]] production plant, with [[Dublin]] liaising through its Mexican embassy to secure its return and the release of imprisoned managers. [https://www.ft.com/content/5aaf0e52-ad21-11e8-94bd-cba20d67390c (''Financial Times'')]
